name: LeaveBoard
summary: LeaveBoard is free for up to 9 employees and charges $1.35 per employee a month on its Pro plan, which adds priority support and advanced leave policies. The vendor prices companies above 81 employees on Enterprise. Annual accrual, carry-over and pro-rata amounts are calculated automatically.

facts.text: The Free plan is capped at 9 employees. Pro has no stated employee limit, and Enterprise is described for companies larger than 81 employees with an account manager and no published price.
Yearly billing is marked as saving 17%, but the yearly per-employee price is not shown. Prices exclude EU VAT for European businesses, and card payments run through Braintree.
The leave page lists automatic annual accrual, carry-over and pro-rata calculation, with allowances that can differ by employee, and annual, office and team calendar views.
Leave-of-absence reports for payroll export in XLS format. The page mentions single sign-on and daily backups and names no security certification.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 9 employees, with time off tracking, leave policies and an absence calendar

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Adds priority support and advanced leave policies. The page does not say whether the shown price is monthly or yearly billing

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For companies larger than 81 employees; adds an account manager

hiddenCosts: The pricing page does not state whether $1.35 is the monthly or the yearly-billing rate; yearly billing is marked as saving 17% with no figure.
Prices exclude EU VAT for European businesses.

security.ssoPlan: Google, Outlook or Slack sign-in; plan not stated

contract.cancellation: No long-term contract; cancel at any time, effective at the next renewal.
contract.dataExport: Leave reports for payroll in XLS format.
